name: sync-gbrain
conclusion_quantitative: sync-gbrain (Ask) specifies 5 of 5 categories: 10+ autonomy limits, 8 clarification rules, 8 approval gates, 3 validation rules, 10+ escalation rules. Strongest: autonomy limits.
conclusion_qualitative: sync-gbrain keeps the gbrain knowledge base current with the repository's code and refreshes the search guidance in CLAUDE.md (gstack). Its shared preamble asks about setup and gets a yes before upgrades, syncing or other skills, while spawned sessions decide alone. The sync itself stops with a clear message when policy, the CLI or the configuration prevents it, asks before a long full reindex, and checks the indexed page count and stage results before reporting done.

autonomy_limits.conclusion_quantitative: 10+ autonomy limits (10 mandatory, 0 advisory; 5 conditional), mostly prose.
autonomy_limits.conclusion_qualitative: There are 10 or more rules (the first 10 are kept), all strict, 5 tied to a situation, mostly running text. The front matter limits the agent to `Bash`, `Read`, `Write`, `Edit`, `Glob`, `Grep` and `AskUserQuestion`. When proactive mode is off it does not start or suggest skills on its own; orchestrator-spawned sessions skip setup prompts and pick the recommended option. When it cannot ask the user it must not decide silently, write decisions to the plan or stop on prose. The sync question never blocks the skill, and it auto-commits only in continuous checkpoint mode and pushes only when that is switched on.

If `CHECKPOINT_MODE` is `"explicit"`: ignore this section unless a skill or user asks to commit.

escalation.conclusion_quantitative: 10+ escalation rules (9 mandatory, 1 advisory; 4 conditional), mostly list.
escalation.conclusion_qualitative: There are 10 or more rules (the first 10 are kept), 9 strict and 1 counted as a suggestion (it contains "consider"), 4 tied to a situation, mostly bullet points. Without a way to ask the user the skill is blocked and waits. The agent stops and reassesses when going in circles, reports concerns and blockers, and escalates after 3 failures, on security doubts or unverifiable work. It stops with a message when the repository's trust policy denies syncing or the local gbrain CLI, configuration or database is missing or broken, and tells the user when it continues without the code stage.
